plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Management - Project Management Emphasis program page (poid=11111) and its linked official degree map, 'Management Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Project Management (Campus)' (the workbook also carries a 'Project Management (Online)' tab), last updated/reviewed July 27, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the BS: the program is a combined BA/BS, the catalog prints a single combined Total Credits, BA/BS Degree: 120, and the map expressly states that students electing the BA take 16 credits of one foreign language, which are not included in the map; the BS version is recorded, following the prior-wave pattern for combined BA/BS programs. Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (16/14/15/15/15/15/15/15) and the plan to the catalog's printed Total Credits, BA/BS Degree: 120. Per the catalog, students must complete the required business foundation, business core, and upper-division major classes with a GPA of 2.5 or better, and a business major must earn a grade of 'C' (2.0) or better in all required Pre-Business, Business Core, and major courses. The catalog's Management Core (18.5 credits) and Project Management Emphasis Courses (12 credits) are exercised exactly by the map (the Management Core's 3-credit upper-division choice is the map's 'Major Business Upper-division Elective*' row in Spring Year 3, carrying the catalog's prefix list). The Business Elective block (12 credits) is exercised by MGMT 2000, MGMT 2020 and MGMT 4950 (9 credits, all in the catalog's Business Elective list) with the remaining 3 credits carrying no labelled map row and sitting within the map's free-elective rows as printed (23.5 credits in all). DISCLOSED catalog error and catalog-vs-map differences, transcribed as printed and not reconciled: (1) the catalog page heads this program's curriculum 'Management - Human Resource Management Curriculum (74.5 Credits)' although the page is the Project Management Emphasis page; its blocks (Pre-Business 23 + Business Core 9 + Management Core 18.5 + Project Management Emphasis 12 + Business Elective 12) sum to the printed 74.5. (2) The catalog's Pre-Business block prints MATH 1050 College Algebra at 1 credit, the value at which the block sums to its printed 23 credits, while the map prints MATH 1050 at 4 credits, the value recorded here and the value printed for MATH 1050 on the other SUU business program pages collected; at the map value the map exercises the Pre-Business courses at 26 credits. (3) The catalog prints MKTG 3010 Marketing Principles at 2.5 credits, the value at which its Business Core block sums to its printed 9 credits, while the map prints MKTG 3010 at 3 credits, the value recorded here and the value printed for MKTG 3010 on the other SUU business program pages collected; at the map values the map exercises the Business Core courses at 9.5 credits. The catalog's naive block sum (BA 16 or BS 12 + GE 28+ + Curriculum 74.5) exceeds 120 only because the BS requirement may be met through GE and several curriculum courses carry GE tags. Catalog course titles are recorded where the map shortens them.
